Duracell Coppertop (Premium) What it is: High-performance batteries built for heavy power use. Best for: Xbox controllers, motorized toys, smart door locks, and bright flashlights. The Verdict: Buy these for power-hungry devices so you aren't swapping them out constantly.
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B08XCLGJ3W
🔋
Duracell Everyday (Standard) What it is: Basic, budget-friendly alkaline batteries. Best for: TV remotes, wall clocks, basic wireless mice, and calculators. The Verdict: Buy these for low-drain household items. Paying extra for premium chemistry here is a waste of money. TL;DR: Save your cash and use "Everyday" for your remotes and clocks, but spend the extra on "Coppertop" for your gaming controllers and heavy-duty gadgets!
